author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Async clipboard completion can outlive component unmount
findings.consequence: If the user presses `i` and immediately navigates away while `navigator.clipboard.writeText` is still pending, the unmounted component can still call `showShortcutMessage`, mutate its ref, and create a timeout that the `onBeforeUnmount` cleanup did not see. The leak is bounded to the 2200 ms timer, but it is still avoidable lifecycle work after teardown.
findings.evidence: Line 33 awaits `copyProductionValue(props.profile.authorId)` and lines 34/36 call `showShortcutMessage` after the await. The unmount cleanup on lines 41-43 only removes the listener and clears an already-existing timer; it does not prevent this in-flight async handler from creating a new timer after unmount.
findings.recommendation: Track mounted state or a monotonically increasing invocation token, set it false/invalid in `onBeforeUnmount`, and after the await return before calling `showShortcutMessage` when the component is no longer mounted.
verification: Inspected `app/lib/production-shortcuts.ts` for shortcut guard and clipboard helper behavior.
Used read-only inspection commands only: `sed`, `nl -ba`, and `rg`.
Reviewed owned units, named imports, direct callers, generated API-adjacent type usage through `AuthorProfileView`, and relevant tests found by repository search.
